scope: diagnostic candidate versus maintained canonical; not future native installed selection

class_conclusions.mapping_justification: Current generator represents EXACT_MATCH/LEXICAL_MATCH as LexicalMatching and SYNONYM_MATCH/MANUAL_CURATION as ManualMappingCuration. Judge actual owner route independently; method alone does not choose own-identifier identity predicate.
class_conclusions.confidence: This cell is the producer quality grade (0.99 for exact/synonym and0.9 otherwise, with explicit registry/rule branches); it is not measured certainty and does not lift a negative scientific decision.
class_conclusions.mapping_date: Current value records the latest valid actual owner curation-history date, including permanent-ID allocation or scoped source correction. It is not a new literature-review or procurement date.
class_conclusions.source: Generator provenance names actual stored evidence/last curator and frozen KG lineage. It is not independent chemical corroboration. Native selection must preserve all previous canonical source tokens and comments separately.
class_conclusions.comment: Candidate explanation is not a license to erase prior comments. Full native selection must retain original canonical comments/source evidence and document removal histories.
class_conclusions.validation_method: Empty current stamp prevents replay of historical approval. Original stamps remain evidence in beforeimages/history, not current validation.
class_conclusions.other: Only same-owner resolving labels may remain. Reject acid/anion aliases and false identity labels; preserve exact suppression history. Any current whole-row hold remains even if a token is removed.
class_conclusions.object_label: Label must be canonical or an accepted synonym of this exact target. A label update is not a new identity or relation.
class_conclusions.subject_id: Persistent MIM concept remains; no mint/merge/split is inferred from a candidate row delta.
class_conclusions.subject_label: Retained owner label and scientific scope govern this row; similar source text does not create a new concept.
class_conclusions.predicate_id: Current relation preserves exact own identity or separately typed inexact relation. No broad/close/narrow row is subclass evidence.
class_conclusions.object_id: Actual target must be supported at current form/scope; omission/insertion is assessed separately from permanent owner identity.
class_conclusions.object_source: Namespace provenance describes the actual target namespace; it cannot substitute for scientific evidence.

limits: Native selection may restore sources/comments. Complete final per-row publication decisions are pending actual selection and native reviewer inspection. The 165 non-bookkeeping candidate entries include original held cases and require exact current full-row comparison; this aggregate class explanation does not approve them.
